title: Agents that run businesses: autonomy, economics and failure in production
thesis: AI agents can run narrow business workflows end to end, but evidence of autonomous agents running whole businesses is thin; measured gains come with human oversight and most failures come from long-horizon reliability.
audience: Founders and operators deciding which business workflows to hand to agents

questions.question: What happens when LLM agents are given a business to run, in experiments and benchmarks (Vending-Bench, Project Vend, TheAgentCompany)?
What measured productivity and cost results do companies report from agents in customer support and operations?
queries: generative AI customer support productivity study
AI agents customer service deployment results

questions.question: How are business agents built: architectures, tools, orchestration and human-in-the-loop?
How reliable are agents on long-horizon tasks and how is that capability trending?
queries: measuring AI ability to complete long tasks

questions.question: Why do agent projects fail or get cancelled, and what risks (errors, security, liability) show up?
queries: why do multi-agent LLM systems fail
AI agent security prompt injection tools
